faq_items.question: Which digital agent is best suited for a dental clinic or medical center?
faq_items.answer: For dental and medical clinics, the most effective setup is our 24/7 Autonomous Voice Agent paired with the WhatsApp/Web Agent. They answer inbound calls instantly when the front desk is busy or after hours, qualify appointment reasons (routine check-ups, pain/urgency, orthodontics, or aesthetics), provide treatment details, book directly into your medical management software, and send automatic reminders to reduce patient no-shows by up to 70%.

faq_items.question: How long does it take to implement and activate digital agents in my business?
faq_items.answer: Standard implementation takes between 7 and 14 business days. In the first week, we audit your intake workflow and train the agents with your exact brand tone, service catalog, and FAQs. Next, we integrate with your telephony, CRM, or calendar and perform thorough calibration tests before full launch.

faq_items.question: How do agents integrate with our existing software, telephony, or CRM?
faq_items.answer: Our agents connect natively or via API/webhooks with your existing tech stack (WhatsApp Business, Google Calendar, Outlook, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Holded, Gesden, Cloudbeds, etc.) and phone systems via smart call forwarding. You don't need to change software or alter your daily operations.

faq_items.question: What is the difference between a traditional chatbot and a SKIRION Digital Agent?
faq_items.answer: Traditional chatbots rely on rigid button menus and decision trees that often frustrate customers. SKIRION Digital Agents are powered by generative AI and neural voice synthesis: they understand natural conversation, handle customer objections, and perform live actions such as checking real-time availability or logging qualified leads directly into your CRM.

faq_items.question: How do we measure the return on investment (ROI) and agent performance?
faq_items.answer: You receive transparent real-time analytics from day one: average response time (reduced to under 5 seconds), autonomous resolution rate (typically 75%–85%), after-hours appointments and leads captured, and saved team hours on repetitive administrative tasks.
